lines.en: Lesson 133
Sensational news!
Listen to the tape then answer this question.
lines.zh: 听录音，然后回答这个问题。

lines.en: What reasons did Karen Marsh give for wanting to retire?
lines.zh: 凯伦·马什给出哪些理由想要退休？

lines.en: Have you just made a new film, Miss Marsh?
lines.zh: 马什小姐，您刚拍了一部新电影吗？

lines.en: Yes, I have.
Are you going to make another?
No, I'm not.
I'm going to retire.
I feel very tired.
I don't want to make another film for a long time.
lines.zh: 我很长时间都不想再拍电影了。

lines.en: Let's buy a newspaper, Liz.
Listen to this!
'Karen Marsh: Sensational News!
By our reporter, Alan Jones.
Karen Marsh arrived at London Airport today.
lines.zh: 凯伦·马什今天抵达伦敦机场。

lines.en: She was wearing a blue dress and a mink coat.
lines.zh: 她穿着一件蓝色连衣裙和一件貂皮大衣。

lines.en: She told me she had just made a new film.
lines.zh: 她告诉我她刚拍了一部新电影。

lines.en: she said she was not going to make another.
She said she was going to retire.
She told reporters she felt very tired and didn't want to make another film for a long time.'
lines.zh: 她告诉记者她感到非常疲倦，并且很长时间都不想再拍电影了。”

lines.en: I wonder why!
